title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: a signed initial declaration must be on file before a review is decided
content:
## Rule
Under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product a review is decided only when the shipper's initial declaration is on file as signed, which the declaration file shows by a submission whose type is initial and whose outcome is signed. Without such a submission, no decision on the review is recorded.

## What the declaration file must show
| Declarations on the acceptance's file | Signed initial declaration on file |
|---|---|
| at least one initial declaration with outcome signed | yes |
| initial declarations only awaiting signature, returned for correction or withdrawn | no |
| signed amendment declarations but no signed initial declaration | no |
| no declaration at all | no |

## Points of judgement
- *Does a signed amendment stand in for a signed initial declaration?* No; the condition looks only for a submission whose type is initial and whose outcome is signed.
- *The customer says the declaration was signed and sent — is that enough?* The condition is read from the declaration file on the line's records.
